boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten distinct, documented study settings in Nimitz Library and Mahan Hall, with stated room-use constraints.

cards.title: Nimitz Library Room 301
cards.subtitle: Nimitz Library, third floor
cards.notes: Reserve this eight-person room when your group needs a whiteboard, screen, and VHS/DVD player; reservations open within the library’s stated window.
cards.short_summary: A reservable group room with presentation tools.
cards.evidence_claim: Room 301 holds eight people and provides a whiteboard, screen, and VHS/DVD player.
cards.access_notes: Reservable study rooms are on the third floor. Reservations may be made 7 days to 4 hours ahead; unreserved rooms are first-come, first-served.

cards.title: Nimitz Library Room 302
cards.subtitle: Nimitz Library, third floor
cards.notes: Book this four-person room for a quieter session with a whiteboard, chalkboard, and white-noise machine; keep noise reasonable on this floor.
cards.short_summary: A small reservable room with both board types.
cards.evidence_claim: Room 302 holds four people and has a whiteboard, chalkboard, and white-noise machine.
cards.access_notes: Reservable study rooms are on the third floor. Reservations may be made 7 days to 4 hours ahead; unreserved rooms are first-come, first-served.

cards.title: Nimitz Library Room 303
cards.subtitle: Nimitz Library, third floor
cards.notes: Reserve this one-person room when you need an individual desk and a defined work session; release it when another user has an active reservation.
cards.evidence_claim: Room 303 is a one-person room with an individual desk.
cards.access_notes: Reservable study rooms are on the third floor. Reservations may be made 7 days to 4 hours ahead; unreserved rooms are first-come, first-served.

cards.title: Nimitz Library Room 304
cards.subtitle: Nimitz Library, third floor
cards.notes: Use this one-person, desk-equipped room for independent reading or writing; check the reservation calendar before treating it as first-come space.
cards.evidence_claim: Room 304 is a one-person room with an individual desk.
cards.access_notes: Reservable study rooms are on the third floor. Reservations may be made 7 days to 4 hours ahead; unreserved rooms are first-come, first-served.

cards.title: Nimitz Library Room 313
cards.subtitle: Nimitz Library, third floor
cards.notes: Plan a four-person working session here when you need HDMI display sharing and a rolling whiteboard; reserve ahead or use it when unreserved.
cards.short_summary: A reservable collaboration room with HDMI.
cards.evidence_claim: Room 313 holds four people and has a collaboration table with an HDMI-connected screen and a rolling whiteboard.
cards.access_notes: Reservable study rooms are on the third floor. Reservations may be made 7 days to 4 hours ahead; unreserved rooms are first-come, first-served.

cards.title: Nimitz Library Room 315
cards.subtitle: Nimitz Library, third floor
cards.notes: Bring a four-person discussion or problem set to this room for its chalkboard and rolling whiteboard, observing its quiet-floor location.
cards.short_summary: A reservable small room built around writable surfaces.
cards.evidence_claim: Room 315 holds four people and provides a chalkboard and rolling whiteboard.
cards.access_notes: Reservable study rooms are on the third floor. Reservations may be made 7 days to 4 hours ahead; unreserved rooms are first-come, first-served.

cards.title: Nautilus Room
cards.subtitle: Nimitz Library, main floor
cards.notes: Check the posted schedule, then use this classroom for individual or group study when no library class, meeting, or event has priority.
cards.short_summary: A main-floor classroom available around library programming.
cards.evidence_claim: Anyone in the library may use the Nautilus Room for individual or group study when it is not in use for another purpose.
cards.access_notes: Library classes, meetings, and events take priority; schedules are typically posted on or near the room door.

cards.title: Nimitz Library Room Ni227
cards.subtitle: Nimitz Library
cards.notes: Use this library classroom for solo or group work only when it is unscheduled; look for the room-door schedule before setting up.
cards.short_summary: A classroom that becomes study space between scheduled uses.
cards.evidence_claim: Anyone in the library may use Ni227 for individual or group study when it is not in use for another purpose.
cards.access_notes: Library classes, meetings, and events take priority; schedules are typically posted on or near the room door.

cards.entity_name: Nimitz Library Room Ni201 Collaboration Table
cards.title: Ni201 Collaboration Table
cards.subtitle: Nimitz Library, Room Ni201
cards.notes: Use the HDMI-ready collaboration table for shared-screen work, but confirm the room is not reserved before beginning a group session.
cards.short_summary: A first-come table designed for quick laptop sharing.
cards.evidence_claim: A collaboration table in Ni201 allows easy HDMI plug-in and is first-come, first-served unless the room is reserved.
cards.access_notes: Available first-come, first-served unless Room Ni201 is already reserved.

cards.title: Hart Room
cards.subtitle: Mahan Hall
cards.notes: Choose this quiet room away from Bancroft Hall and Nimitz Library for study or a casual meeting; midshipmen receive first-come, first-served priority.
cards.short_summary: A historic Mahan Hall room reserved for academic support.
cards.evidence_claim: USNA policy designates the Hart Room in Mahan Hall for midshipmen’s study and casual meetings.
cards.source_title: Provost Instruction 5293.1: Hart Room Policy, Requests, Scheduling, and Usage
cards.access_notes: Use is exclusively in support of midshipmen as a study area or casual-meeting space; midshipmen requesting reservations have first-come, first-served priority.
